placements.why: The document's content is entirely about deployment process governance — a mandatory gate, its scope, its rationale, and its ownership. No existing strata category exists to hold this organizational category of release-process decisions.
placements.title: governing what may ship through a release pipeline
placements.frame: What preconditions, gates, and ownership structures govern artifacts as they move through a release train?

placements.title: a signed manifest becomes a non-negotiable precondition for deployment
placements.frame: Is the deployment process being constrained by a mandatory signing requirement that enters as a settled operational rule rather than a proposal?
placements.why: All five substantive segments support a single thematic subject: the signed release manifest gate imposed on the Meridian release train. src-1 issues the gate as a directive, src-2 supplies its rationale as evidence for why the gate exists, and src-4/5/6 restate the gate's mandate, scope, and ownership as settled operational facts. No existing leaf holds this theme.
